picks.editorial_note: A $334 million grant to NCSA from Schmidt Sciences is one of the largest single AI-computing investments in this dataset, materially expanding national supercomputing capacity for scientific discovery.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's parallel entry into the Schmidt Science Computing Network establishes the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, pairing major new funding with a high-value cross-institutional computing partnership.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment backing 20 Turing AI Fellows is a substantial national commitment to AI research capacity in the UK, spanning fields from turbulence modeling to human-AI interaction.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's FemtoMind project applies agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations as part of the multi-laboratory Genesis Mission, representing a genuine methodological advance in using AI for fundamental physics.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and its AI4Coral partnership with KAUST pairs AI and robotics for automated coral reef monitoring, a notable cross-border academic collaboration with real environmental application.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial College spinout Cogitat by Swiss neurotech firm Indivi validates the commercial viability of its brain foundation model, marking a concrete translation of academic AI research into industry.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 17 other institutions cataloging 95 ways advanced AI could lead to catastrophic outcomes is a significant contribution to the AI safety discourse shaping future policy and governance debates.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding a third of the global AI supply chain invisible to government oversight highlights a critical gap in AI governance with direct implications for regulatory policy.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and CNRS's new joint International Research Laboratory on AI-driven metabolism research formalizes a significant transatlantic academic partnership targeting global health challenges.
picks.title: Metabolism, AI and global health: Imperial and France's CNRS celebrate launch of joint laboratory

picks.editorial_note: Indiana University's new Applied Research Center coordinates university-wide expertise to expand government and industry partnerships on national security priorities, reflecting growing university-government AI collaboration.
picks.title: Indiana University expands national security research partnerships through Applied Research Center
